parameters.content:
## 📲 MISSED-CALL TEXT-BACK AI BOOKER
**What it does:** A missed call hits your Twilio number → the caller instantly gets a friendly SMS → their replies are handled by an AI agent that classifies intent (booking / quote / existing job / wrong number) and books them straight into your Google Calendar — while a daily sweeper nudges anyone who went quiet.

**You'll need:**
- Twilio account with a phone number (twilio.com/try-twilio) — voice status-callback + SMS webhook point at this workflow's URL
- OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com/signup)
- Google Sheets + Google Calendar OAuth2 credentials
- A Telegram bot (telegram.org → @BotFather → /newbot) + your chat ID

**Status flow in Sheets:** `NEW` → `CONTACTED` → `REPLIED` → `BOOKED` (plus `DROPPED`, `NUDGED`)

## STEP 1 — Twilio webhook + instant response
Incoming SMS or missed-call status callback → Respond-to-Webhook returns empty TwiML immediately so Twilio is satisfied → normalize the payload (From / Body / CallStatus → event_type).

## STEP 2 — Config + 24h dedupe
Two Config Set nodes hold every editable value (business name, numbers, calendar ID, AI profile, model). For missed calls: read the log — if this caller was already texted in the last 24h, stop (no spam).

## STEP 3 — Instant text-back + logging
New missed call → row appended with status `NEW` → friendly SMS goes out via Twilio HTTP → sheet flips to `CONTACTED`.

## STEP 4 — AI classifies the reply
Inbound SMS → conversation history rebuilt from the Sheets log → AI Agent (gpt-4o-mini) + Structured Output Parser returns {intent, summary, missing_fields, suggested_reply}.

## STEP 5 — Booking branch
intent=booking + all details present → Google Calendar event → confirmation SMS → sheet `BOOKED` → Telegram owner alert. Missing details → AI's follow-up question sent, sheet `REPLIED`.

## STEP 6 — Quote / wrong-number branches
quote → quote-capture SMS, `REPLIED`. wrong_number → polite close, `DROPPED`. existing_job / other → friendly acknowledgement, `REPLIED`.

## STEP 7 — Daily no-reply sweeper
Separate schedule flow: scan the log every 2h for `CONTACTED` rows older than 2h with no reply → send exactly one nudge SMS → mark `NUDGED`.

## STEP 8 — Telegram owner alert
Every booked lead fires a one-line Telegram summary to the owner (name/phone, time, what they booked).

assignments.value: PASTE_YOUR_AI_BUSINESS_PROFILE: who you are, services + prices, service area, opening hours, booking rules (e.g. 'Plumbing repairs, $89 call-out, Mon-Sat 8am-6pm, bookings need name + preferred day/time')

nodes.name: Send Instant SMS — Sorry We Missed You

value.Last Message: ={{ 'Sorry we missed your call! This is ' + $('CONFIG — Business Settings').first().json.business_name + '. How can we help? Just reply here and I\'ll get you sorted.' }}

options.systemMessage:
=You are the friendly AI receptionist for {{ $('CONFIG — Business Settings').first().json.business_name }}.

BUSINESS PROFILE:
{{ $('CONFIG — AI + Services').first().json.ai_business_profile }}

Classify the latest customer message. intents: booking (wants an appointment/visit), quote (asks price without booking), existing_job (about an ongoing/completed job), wrong_number (clearly not our customer), other.

If intent=booking, list what's missing before a booking can be made (e.g. preferred day/time, address, phone). If everything needed is present, set booking_start and booking_end to ISO datetimes in the customer's local timezone and leave missing_fields empty.

suggested_reply must be a short SMS-ready reply (max 2 sentences, warm, no jargon). Never invent business details not in the profile. Output ONLY via the structured output parser.

parameters.inputSchema:
{
  "intent": "booking / quote / existing_job / wrong_number / other",
  "summary": "one-line summary of what the customer wants",
  "missing_fields": ["list of booking details still needed, empty when intent != booking or all details are present"],
  "suggested_reply": "short SMS-ready reply, max 2 sentences",
  "booking_start": "ISO datetime of the requested appointment, only when intent=booking and missing_fields is empty",
  "booking_end": "ISO datetime the appointment ends (default: booking_start + 1h), only when intent=booking and missing_fields is empty"
}

value.Last Message: ={{ 'booking confirmed for ' + $('AI Agent — Classify + Draft Reply').first().json.output.booking_start }}
